(11:57) gp > compute_K_theory(log_mass) = {
  M = vector(#log_mass, i, 10^log_mass[i]);
  M_sorted = vecsort(M);
  n = #M;
  if (n % 2 == 0,
    M0 = (M_sorted[n/2] + M_sorted[n/2 + 1]) / 2,
    M0 = M_sorted[(n+1)/2]
  );
  sum_M_over_M0 = sum(i=1, n, M[i] / M0);
  sum_M0_over_M = sum(i=1, n, M0 / M[i]);
  K_theory = sum_M_over_M0 / sum_M0_over_M;
  return K_theory;
}
(11:57) gp > compute_skewness(log_mass) = {
  n = #log_mass;
  if (n < 3, return("n too small"));
  mean = vecsum(log_mass) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^2) / (n - 1);
  sd = sqrt(variance);
  mu3 = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^3) / n;
  skewness = (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * mu3 / sd^3;
  return skewness;
}
(11:57) gp > compute_median(v) = {
  v_sorted = vecsort(v);
  n = #v;
  if (n % 2 == 0,
    return (v_sorted[n/2] + v_sorted[n/2 + 1]) / 2,
    return v_sorted[(n+1)/2]
  );
}

(12:04) gp > compute_K_theory(log_mass) = {
  M = vector(#log_mass, i, 10^log_mass[i]);
  M_sorted = vecsort(M);
  n = #M;
  if (n % 2 == 0,
    M0 = (M_sorted[n/2] + M_sorted[n/2 + 1]) / 2,
    M0 = M_sorted[(n+1)/2]
  );
  sum_M_over_M0 = sum(i=1, n, M[i] / M0);
  sum_M0_over_M = sum(i=1, n, M0 / M[i]);
  K_theory = sum_M_over_M0 / sum_M0_over_M;
  return K_theory;
}
(12:04) gp > compute_skewness(log_mass) = {
  n = #log_mass;
  if (n < 3, return("n too small"));
  mean = vecsum(log_mass) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^2) / (n - 1);
  sd = sqrt(variance);
  mu3 = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^3) / n;
  skewness = (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * mu3 / sd^3;
  return skewness;
}
(12:04) gp > compute_median(v) = {
  v_sorted = vecsort(v);
  n = #v;
  if (n % 2 == 0,
    return (v_sorted[n/2] + v_sorted[n/2 + 1]) / 2,
    return v_sorted[(n+1)/2]
  );
}

  v_sorted = vecsort(v);
  n = #v_sorted;

    (v_sorted[n/2] + v_sorted[n/2 + 1]) / 2,
    v_sorted[(n+1)/2]
  )
}

(13:20) gp > compute_kurtosis(log_mass) = {
  n = #log_mass;
  mean = sum(i=1, n, log_mass[i]) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^2) / (n - 1);
  stddev = sqrt(variance);
  fourth_moment = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^4) / n;
  kurtosis = fourth_moment / stddev^4;
  kurtosis - 3  // excess kurtosis
}

(13:38) gp > compute_kurtosis(log_mass) = {
  n = #log_mass;
  mean = sum(i=1, n, log_mass[i]) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^2) / (n - 1);
  stddev = sqrt(variance);
  fourth_moment = sum(i=1, n, (log_mass[i] - mean)^4) / n;
  kurtosis = fourth_moment / stddev^4;
  kurtosis - 3  \ return excess kurtosis
}

(10:20) gp > compute_L_cosmo(s) = {
  local(L_cosmo = 1, rank = 0);
  for (k = 1, 5,
    start = if(k == 1, 1, end_indices[k-1] + 1);
    end = end_indices[k];
    bin_M = M_sorted[start..end];
    M0_k = vecmedian(bin_M);  /* Median mass in the bin */
    /* Compute K for rank */
    sum_M_over_M0 = sum(i = 1, #bin_M, bin_M[i] / M0_k);
    sum_M0_over_M = sum(i = 1, #bin_M, M0_k / bin_M[i]);
    K = sum_M_over_M0 / sum_M0_over_M;
    if (abs(K - 1) < 0.2, rank = rank + 1);
    /* Compute L_k(s) */
    L_k = sum(i = 1, #bin_M, (M0_k / bin_M[i])^s);
    L_cosmo = L_cosmo * L_k;
  );
  [L_cosmo, rank];
};

  local(L_cosmo, rank, start, end, bin_M, M0_k, sum_M_over_M0, sum_M0_over_M, K, L_k);
  L_cosmo = 1;
  rank = 0;

    if(k == 1, start = 1, start = end_indices[k-1] + 1);
    end = end_indices[k];

    M0_k = vecmedian(bin_M);
    sum_M_over_M0 = sum(i = 1, #bin_M, bin_M[i] / M0_k);

    L_k = sum(i = 1, #bin_M, (M0_k / bin_M[i])^s);
    L_cosmo = L_cosmo * L_k
  );
  [L_cosmo, rank]
}

  );

(14:16) gp > simulate_log_mass(sample_size, mean_val, std_val) = {
  my(v, i, pair);
  v = vector(sample_size);
  for (i=1, floor(sample_size/2),
    pair = box_muller();
    v[2*i-1] = mean_val + std_val * pair[1];
    if (2*i <= sample_size, v[2*i] = mean_val + std_val * pair[2]);
  );
  if (sample_size % 2 == 1,
    pair = box_muller();
    v[sample_size] = mean_val + std_val * pair[1];
  );
  v
}

(14:16) gp > compute_K_theory(logmass_vec) = {
  my(n = length(logmass_vec), masses, sorted_masses, m0, sum_m_over_m0, sum_m0_over_m, k);
  masses = vector(n, i, 10^logmass_vec[i]);
  sorted_masses = vecsort(masses);
  m0 = sorted_masses[floor((n+1)/2)];
  sum_m_over_m0 = sum(i=1, n, masses[i] / m0);
  sum_m0_over_m = sum(i=1, n, m0 / masses[i]);
  k = sum_m_over_m0 / sum_m0_over_m;
  k
}

(14:16) gp > compute_kurtosis(vec) = {
  my(n = length(vec), mean, m4, variance);

  m4 = sum(i=1, n, (vec[i] - mean)^4) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (vec[i] - mean)^2) / n;
